### Still Good, Still in Control
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-august-30-2026.html
Passage: Matthew 11:2-3
Points:
- John the Baptist wrestled with genuine doubt while locked in prison for his obedience.
- Jesus recognized John's sincere heart and responded to his inquiry without condemnation.
- True biblical faith accepts what God chooses to give rather than demanding what we want.
- Believers are free to bring their honest questions to the Lord when life does not unfold as expected.
- Even when circumstances seem dark, God remains good and in sovereign control.

### When We Lose Heart
Author: Susie Larson
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/when-we-lose-heart-bible-study-minute-may-25-2018.html
Passage: Luke 7:22-23
Points:
- Even spiritual giants like John can experience discouragement during painful seasons of waiting.
- Recalling how God has provided in the past helps restore faith when current answers seem delayed.
- Blaming God during hardship is a spiritual dead end that damages perspective.
- Jesus pronounces a blessing on those who refuse to stumble or take offense over His ways.
- Enduring trials requires trusting that the Father's heart is good and His timing is perfect.
